apply.label: Checkbox in an edit dialog of the photo viewer (coordinates, date and time, Correct the ID): make the change to every photo of the open photo's burst, not just this one. {count} is the number of photos in the burst.
apply.haveCoordinates: Under the Apply to all checkbox in the coordinates dialog: how many photos of the burst already have coordinates; saving replaces them.

bursts.selectWhole: Gallery selection bar button: also select the other photos of each selected photo's burst.
bursts.selectFailed: Error toast when Select whole burst couldn't load a burst's photos.
bursts.badge: On a photo in the grid: how many other photos are in its burst (photos taken in one press of the shutter), like +11.
bursts.burstAndScene: Above the viewer's strip of nearby photos. A scene is the bursts taken one after another at one sighting.
bursts.frame: Accessible name of a photo in the open burst, like Frame 3 of 12.
bursts.burst: Accessible name of a burst tile in the strip: its place among the scene's bursts and its photo count.

ignoreAllConfirm.title: {total} is {count} formatted with digit grouping, like 2,500: every file on the list, including any not shown.

archiveHealth.ignoredAll: Toast after Ignore all. {total} is {count} formatted with digit grouping.

removeConfirm.title: {group} is a group of species the user added from iNaturalist, like Insects; {country} a country name.
removeConfirm.bodyFrees: {size} is a formatted file size, like 12 MB.
removeConfirm.stays: Appended to the confirmation: species with photos aren't removed.

addedSpecies.addedByYou: Beside a group name in the Species downloads list: the user added these species themselves.

addTo.newPlaceholder: Placeholder of the field for creating a new album to add the photos to.
addTo.onlySmart: Add to album dialog when every album is a smart album, which can't take hand-picked photos.

detail.importAlbum: Button: import new photos straight into this album.
detail.shareNeedsServer: Hover text on the greyed-out Share button in the desktop app: public share links need a self-hosted Lifer server.

export.action: Button and album menu item: copy the album's photos into a folder on disk, for a photo frame or USB stick.
export.hide: Closes the export dialog while the copy keeps going in the background.
export.includeSidecars: .xmp sidecars are small files beside RAW photos that hold edits and metadata; keep ".xmp" as is.
export.progress: {done} and {total} are file counts, like "12 of 40 files".
export.reveal: Button after the export finishes in the desktop app: opens the folder in the system file manager.
export.title: {name} is the album's name, chosen by the user.

list.photoCount: Small uppercase pill on an album card.

share.hiddenLink: Shown instead of a share link's URL: the full link is only shown once, when it is created.

smart.matching: Line under a smart album's title; {rules} is a summary of its rules, like "Flight shots". Clicking it opens the rule editor.
smart.exclude: Photo menu and selection action in a smart album: take this photo out even though it matches the album's rules.
smart.excludedCount: Small link under a smart album's title: how many photos the user excluded by hand. Opens a list to restore them.
smart.label: Hover text and screen reader name of the sparkle icon beside smart albums on album cards and the album page. A smart album fills itself from saved Gallery filters instead of hand-picked photos.
smart.matches: Live count in the smart album rule builder, updated as the filters change.
smart.saveFromGallery: Gallery header button: save the current search and filters as a smart album.
smart.shareLive: Shown in a smart album's share panel: the shared page always shows the album's current matches.

summary.dateRange: {from} and {to} are dates in YYYY-MM-DD form.
summary.search: {q} is the Gallery search text the album saves, shown in quotes.
summary.tag: {tag} is one of the user's own photo tags.

photos.isCover: Photo menu item when this photo is the album's cover; choosing it goes back to the automatic cover.

sections.switchLabel: Screen-reader name for the Albums page switch between the albums view and the trips view.
sections.noMatch: On the full list of albums or trips, when the name search finds nothing. {query} is what was typed.

form.namePlaceholder: Example name for an API key, shown greyed out in the empty field.
form.read: Checkbox column: allow reading this resource.
form.write: Checkbox column: allow changing this resource.

apiKeys.intro: <guide> and <openapi> wrap links. new-lifer: a lifer is a species photographed for the first time ever.
apiKeys.revoke: Button: permanently disable an API key.

revokeConfirm.title: {name} is the API key's name, chosen by the user.

scopes.gallery: Row label in the API key permission grid: the resource a key can access.
scopes.lifeList: Row label in the API key permission grid. Life list: the user's list of species photographed (a birding term).

apiKeys.permission: One permission of an API key, like Albums: Write. {resource} is a row of the permission grid, {access} is Read or Write.

archivedSpecies.title: Page title: species the user chose to leave out of their collection counts (archived).

login.taglineSetup: Sign-in page, shown once before any account exists. Species-indexed: photos organised by species.
login.connectedTo: Desktop app connected to a Lifer server. {server} is the server's address.
login.useLocal: Desktop app: switch from the connected server back to the photo library stored on this computer.

forgot.truenasIntro: TrueNAS is a NAS operating system. Apps, Shell and lifer are names shown in its interface; keep them in English.
forgot.copyCommand: Screen reader label of a copy button. {command} is a shell command.

coordinates.editName: Link in the location dialog: shows the photo's free-text place name and region fields.
coordinates.titleMany: Title of the dialog for typing GPS coordinates for several selected photos at once.
coordinates.placeholder: An example latitude and longitude in decimal degrees; keep the numbers.
coordinates.preview: {point} is the parsed latitude and longitude, like 49.28270, -123.12070.
coordinates.alsoSetRegion: A checkbox offered when the photo has no region: {region} is the province or country the coordinates fall in.
coordinates.filingUnder: Shown after the user picks one of their saved places for the photos. {name} is the place. Photos that already have the camera's GPS keep that point and only take the place's name.

appearance.title: Dialog title and list name: how the animal in a photo looks (life stage, sex, plumage, colour morph).
appearance.titleMany: Same dialog for several selected photos at once.
appearance.morph: A colour form of one species, like the dark and light morphs of some hawks or the koi pattern of an angelfish.
appearance.leaveAsIs: Option and placeholder when editing several photos: keep each photo's own value.
appearance.edit: Link beside a photo's appearance badges in the photo viewer; opens the Appearance dialog.
appearance.action: Selection bar action: set the appearance of every selected photo.
appearance.photographedAs: On a species page, before the list of life stages, sexes and morphs among the user's photos of it.

sex.unknown: Looked at, but you can't tell male from female.

plumage.eclipse: Birding term: the dull plumage some male ducks wear after breeding.

reassign.title: Dialog title: the photo was identified as the wrong species; pick the right one.

tagSpecies.title: Dialog title: the photo also shows a second species; pick it.

captureEdit.couldAlsoBe: Heading over the photo's next-likeliest species.

location.placeNamePlaceholder: Example place name shown greyed out in the empty field.
location.placeNameExample: The same greyed-out example, using a place name the user already used in the picked region. {name} is that name.

categories.label: Spoken name of the row of cards at the top of the Collection, one per animal group (Birds, Mammals...); a card filters the list to its group.

addSpecies.intro: "Added by you" must match the label shown on species cards added by hand.
addSpecies.seaZone: Option for a sea zone checklist (a stretch of ocean) next to the region's own. {name} is the zone's name.
addSpecies.ebirdHint: <a> wraps a link to the eBird import in Settings.

addGroups.loadingListPercent: The same, once the size is known. {percent} is a whole number from 0 to 100; keep the % sign.
addGroups.loadingList: In the Add animal groups dialog, beside a small spinner, while the list of downloadable groups is still on its way (a slow connection). Downloaded groups already show above it.
addGroups.menuItem: Item in the Collection's Add species menu: opens a dialog to download more animal groups (Reptiles, Fish...) for the countries in view. It ends with a link to Species downloads for more countries.
addGroups.allDownloaded: Muted note under the disabled Download species lists item when nothing is left to download.
addGroups.noCountries: Muted note under the disabled Download species lists item on a continent with no downloaded country.
addGroups.downloaded: Under an animal group's checkbox: it's already on this computer for these countries.
addGroups.otherCountries: Footnote in the Download species lists dialog on one country. <more> wraps a link to the Species downloads page in Settings, where other countries can be downloaded.
addGroups.onlyDownloaded: On a continent or World: groups are offered only for downloaded countries. <more> wraps a link to Settings > Species and import > Species downloads.
addGroups.summary: What the user picked: {count} groups, {size} a formatted file size like 45 MB.
addGroups.summaryNoSize: The same while the size (photos included) isn't known yet, briefly on a first start; ends with an ellipsis like other in-progress notes.
addGroups.title: Dialog title. {countries} is a list of up to three country names, like "Canada and United States".
addGroups.titleCount: Dialog title for more than three countries; the names are listed under it.
addGroups.addOther: Item in the Collection's Add species menu: opens one dialog with tabs to search for a species, add a group from iNaturalist, or paste a list of names.

breadcrumb.moreAreas: Last pill in the row of a country's areas (states, provinces) when they don't fit on two rows; opens a list of the rest. {count} is how many more.
breadcrumb.noAreaMatch: Shown in that list when nothing matches what the user typed.
breadcrumb.searchAreas: Placeholder of the search box in that list.
breadcrumb.ofTotal: Follows a large number of species photographed, e.g. "42 of 310 photographed". {total} is a formatted number.
breadcrumb.inDownloadedCountries: Appended to "of 310 photographed" for a continent or World, where only downloaded countries count.
breadcrumb.seen: {count} is a formatted number of species seen but not yet photographed.
breadcrumb.areasIn: Label before buttons for the provinces or states inside a region. {region} is the region's name.
breadcrumb.noCountries: <a> wraps a link to the Species downloads page.

noHubCountries.title: Shown on a continent or other grouping of countries when none of its countries are downloaded yet.

noSearchMatch.description: {shortcut} is the keyboard shortcut for the search palette: ⌘K on a Mac, Ctrl K elsewhere.

packPrompt.size: {count} is the number of species in the download; {size} is a file size like 12 MB.
packPrompt.taxonBanner: {taxon} is a lowercase animal group name in English, like "fish" or "butterflies"; {region} is a region name.
packPrompt.taxonNotDownloaded: {taxon} is a lowercase animal group name, like "fish".
packPrompt.noPack: <a> wraps a link to the Species downloads page. {region} is a region name.
packPrompt.otherTaxaGroupTitle: Empty list heading. {group} is an iNaturalist group name in lowercase, e.g. "insects" or "fungi"; {region} is a place name.
packPrompt.otherTaxaBody: Other species: the catch-all category for species Lifer has no dataset for, added by hand from iNaturalist.
packPrompt.seaZones: Ocean areas are separate downloads of sea life (fish, marine mammals, invertebrates, sea turtles) near a region. {region} is the land region's name.
packPrompt.searchSpecies: Button on the empty Other species view: opens Add other species on its search tab.

toolbar.recordsSection: Section title in the collection Filters menu, over filters for species that are rarely recorded or not recorded in decades.
toolbar.whenSection: Section title in the collection Filters menu, over the "likely this month" and year filters.
toolbar.showing: Shown when filters hide some species. {shown} and {total} are formatted numbers.
toolbar.seaZones: Label before checkboxes for sea zones (stretches of ocean) whose sea life can be added to the region's list.
toolbar.includeLand: With a sea zone ticked: also show the land region's species. {region} is the region's name.
toolbar.ghostOnly: Filter: only species rarely documented anywhere.
toolbar.view: Button opening the layout options (grouping, sort, card size).
toolbar.vagrants: Vagrant: a bird or animal recorded far outside its normal range.
toolbar.groupBroad: Group species by broad group, e.g. birds of prey, waterfowl.
toolbar.sortTaxonomic: Sort in taxonomic order, as printed field guides do.
toolbar.countPhotosFrom: Label of a choice in the View menu on a region's checklist: a species counts as photographed only with a photo taken in the chosen place. The other choices are place names, like Canada or Alberta, which come from data and aren't translated.
toolbar.countPhotosAnywhere: Choice beside place names under "Include photos from": photos taken anywhere in the world count.
toolbar.photosTaken: Label of a filter on a region's checklist that narrows the photographed species by where their photos were taken.
toolbar.photosTakenAnywhere: Choice under "Photos taken": no narrowing, photos from anywhere in the world.
toolbar.photosTakenHere: Choice under "Photos taken": only species photographed inside the region. {region} is a place name like Canada.
toolbar.photosTakenElsewhere: Choice under "Photos taken": only species whose photos were all taken outside the region. {region} is a place name like Canada.
toolbar.arrange: Small heading in the View menu over the choices that order and size the cards (group, sort, size, what comes first).
toolbar.counting: Small heading in the View menu over "Include photos from": which photos count toward the photographed total.
toolbar.nameSettings: Link at the bottom of the View menu to Settings > General, where the species name and badge choices are.
toolbar.sizeColumns: Screen reader text for the card Size slider when cards stretch to fill each row: how many cards fit across.
toolbar.mainName: Label of a choice in the View menu: which species name each card leads with.
toolbar.mainNameCommon: Option: lead with the common name, e.g. American Robin.
toolbar.mainNameScientific: Option: lead with the scientific (Latin) name, e.g. Turdus migratorius.
toolbar.alsoShow: Label before checkboxes in the View menu: what else shows under the species' main name on each card.
toolbar.alsoCommon: Checkbox: also show the common name (when the scientific name is the main name).
toolbar.alsoScientific: Checkbox: also show the scientific (Latin) name (when the common name is the main name).
toolbar.groupSpecies: View menu group option: one card per species, opened to see what's inside.
toolbar.uncollectedColour: View menu checkbox on the Collection page: show covers of species the user has not photographed in full colour instead of the default grey. Off by default. Sentence case.
toolbar.uncollectedColourTitle: Tooltip for the uncollected-in-colour checkbox in the View menu.
toolbar.showMapPins: View menu checkbox on the Collection page: show pins on the region map where the user photographed each species. On by default.
toolbar.showRarityTags: View menu checkbox on the Collection, trip and album pages: show the rarity tier pill (Common, Rare...) on each species card. On by default. Sentence case.
toolbar.showGroupProgress: View menu checkbox on the Collection, trip and album pages: show how many species the user has photographed in each animal group (Birds, Mammals...), as a row of cards over the list and as a large count heading each group. On by default. Sentence case.

map.noPins: Shown on the Collection map when no photo here has coordinates. <placeLink> opens the Gallery map's Needs placing tray, where photos get a location.
map.photosHere: Hover card of a species pin: how many of the user's photos of that species were taken at this place. {formatted} is {count} with digit grouping.
map.speciesHere: Hover card of a group of species pins merged at this zoom: how many different species it holds. {formatted} is {count} with digit grouping.
map.pinsHere: Line in the card over a cluster on the Collection map, under its species count: the number on the cluster's disc counts pins, one for each species at each spot, so it can be higher than the species count. {formatted} is the pin count, like 1,204.
map.resetView: Button on the Collection map once zoomed in: go back to the starting view of the whole region.
map.viewSpecies: Link in a species pin's hover card on the Collection map: opens the species page.
map.openPhotos: Screen reader name of the photo in a species pin's hover card; clicking it opens that species' photos at this place in the photo viewer. {name} is the species name.
map.photosFailed: Toast when clicking a species pin on the Collection map couldn't load its photos.

collectionStats.rarityFor: Screen reader label of the picker choosing which region's rarity the counts use.
collectionStats.overall: Option: count each species' overall rarity rather than a region's.

commandPalette.inRegion: Chip in the command palette: results are limited to {region}, a region name.
commandPalette.searchEverywhere: Screen reader label of the button that removes the region chip. {region} is a region name.

groups.speciesRegionFirst: Heading of species results, ranked with {region} (a region name) first.
groups.tripPhotosNamed: Heading of photo results from the trip being viewed. {name} is the trip's name.
groups.albumPhotosNamed: Heading of photo results from the album being viewed. {name} is the album's name.
groups.goTo: Heading of the list of app pages to jump to.

inat.noLocalMatch: {query} is the user's search text. Opens a search of iNaturalist instead.

api.desktop_only: API error code desktop_only: the server refused an action that only the desktop app (with its local library) can do.
api.no_region: API error code no_region: the chosen place has no matching Lifer region to put species on.
api.not_found: API error code not_found: the thing asked for does not exist (any more).
api.wrong_state: API error code wrong_state: the action does not apply to the item's current status, for example resuming a list that is not paused.
api.missing_scope: API error code missing_scope: an app key lacks a permission the action needs.
api.not_imported_by_key: API error code not_imported_by_key: an app key may only add species to photos it imported itself.
api.primary_species: API error code primary_species: the species to add is already the photo's main species.
api.unknown_species: API error code unknown_species: the species id given is not in the catalog.
api.folder_unavailable: API error code folder_unavailable: the folder picked as a place photos live isn't reachable (an unplugged drive or a network share that isn't connected), so it wasn't added.
api.immich_too_old: API error code immich_too_old: linking an Immich photo server that runs a version older than Lifer supports. The English server message names both versions.
api.immich_unreachable: API error code immich_unreachable: any failure talking to the linked Immich photo server (offline, wrong address, API key rejected or missing permissions).
api.library_folder_unavailable: API error code library_folder_unavailable: the photo library folder was moved, deleted or is on an unplugged drive, so a save failed.
api.invalid_request: API error code invalid_request: the server rejected malformed input. The English server message names the field; this is the generic version.
api.model_mismatch: API error code model_mismatch: a recognition request used vectors from a different species-matching model than the one this Lifer ranks with.
api.no_checklist: API error code no_checklist: a species can't be added to a region (like a continent) that has no species checklist of its own.
api.no_video_frames: API error code no_video_frames: species matching couldn't decode any frames from an uploaded video.
api.not_added: API error code not_added: removing a species the user hadn't added to a region's or sea zone's checklist.
api.pack_index_unavailable: API error code pack_index_unavailable: the list of downloadable regions couldn't be fetched (usually offline).
api.reorganize_failed: API error code reorganize_failed: moving original photo files into the year or location folder layout failed.
api.storage_move_failed: API error code storage_move_failed: moving the photo library to another folder or drive failed.
api.suggestion_failed: API error code suggestion_failed: the species suggestion model couldn't analyse a photo or video (often because it isn't downloaded yet).
api.server_only: API error code server_only: the Immich photo server link only works on a self-hosted Lifer server, so the single-user desktop app refuses it.
api.version_link_refused: API error code version_link_refused: stacking a photo as a version of another failed because the photo already has versions of its own, which must be split out first.
api.maybe_on_inaturalist: Error when a send is held back because the photos may already be on iNaturalist (added there by hand).

folderPicker.roots: Heading of the folder browser at a server's top level, listing the folders the server allows.
folderPicker.allFolders: Row that goes back to the top-level list of allowed folders. Keep the leading two dots.
folderPicker.upOneLevel: Row that goes to the parent folder. Keep the leading two dots.

albumPicker.title: Heading when the Gallery is opened to pick photos for an album. {album} is the album's name.
albumPicker.titleUnnamed: Same heading while the album's name is still loading.

count.matchingRead: {query} is the user's search text; {reading} is how it was understood, e.g. "ducks · Washington · 2024".
count.missingDate: The Gallery's missing-date view, a to-do list of photos with no capture date.
count.missingDateAtLeast: Same, while more photos are still loading.
count.videos: Same, when only videos are shown.

empty.allDated: Empty Gallery in the missing-date view (a to-do list of photos with no date), once every photo has one.
empty.presetsBody: Shown when only the Gallery's default filters are on: by default it hides videos and recordings.

fixRegion.note: Shown above the grid when the Gallery is opened from Stats to give region-less photos a region. Set region names the selection bar's button.

hidden.unhidToast: Toast after unhiding photos that were imported hidden because a culling app rejected them.

gallery.loadingMore: Screen reader label of the spinner at the bottom of the grid.

scope.album: Removable filter chip under the Gallery heading. {name} is the album's name.
scope.trip: Removable filter chip. {name} is the trip's name.
scope.remove: Screen reader label of the chip's x button. {label} is the chip's text.

searchPart.background: A removable token under the Gallery heading for one part of a long search: what's asked for behind the animal. {label} is from the user's search text, e.g. "tree".
searchPart.probably: A search token for a part answered by the picture model's best guess rather than stored facts. {label} is the token's text.
searchPart.parts: Screen reader label of the row of tokens showing how a long search was split into parts.

searchReading.behind: How a photo search was understood: what's asked for behind the animal. {things} is a list from the user's search text.
searchReading.excluding: How a photo search was understood: what the words after "not" or "without" left out. {names} is a list of species, groups or picture words.

readings.lifers: How a photo search was understood: only each species' first photo (a lifer), from words like "lifers" or "my first".
readings.goldenHour: How a photo search was understood: photos taken while the sun was low, just before or after sunrise or sunset.

searchReading.stars: How a photo search was understood: the star rating asked for. {count} is the number of stars.
searchReading.looksLike: How a photo search was understood: the part matched by what the picture looks like. {description} is from the user's search text.
searchReading.more: How a photo search was understood: after the first three species names, how many more matched.

select.selected: {count} is a formatted number of selected photos.
select.addToAlbum: Button in the album picker. {count} is how many photos are selected (blank when none).
select.correctId: Selection bar button: opens a species search to move the selected photos to the species they really show.
select.correctIdTitle: Title of that species search dialog. {count} is how many photos are selected.
select.addTagTitle: Title of the dialog that adds a tag to the selected photos. {count} is how many.
select.rateTitle: Title of the dialog that gives the selected photos a star rating. {count} is how many.
select.more: Selection bar menu button holding the actions that don't fit on the row.
select.none: Shown in the selection bar while no photos are selected yet.
select.setRegion: Button in the selection bar: opens a picker for the country or province where the selected photos were taken.
select.setRegionTitle: Title of that picker. {count} is how many photos are selected.
select.placeOnMap: Selection bar button: opens the map to place the selected photos.

gallery.title: Page title of the Gallery: every photo in the library in one grid.

toolbar.searchPlaceholder: Example search: the Gallery searches photos by what they show.
toolbar.featured: Filter: featured photos, the one each species' card shows.
toolbar.notOnInat: Filter checkbox, shown when iNaturalist is connected: only photos not yet sent to iNaturalist as an observation.
toolbar.missingDate: Filter checkbox: only photos with no capture date.
toolbar.shotKind: Filter heading: the kind of shot, read on two axes (Action and Framing), as Stats counts them.
toolbar.shotAction: Shot type filter group: what the animal is doing (Flying, Behaviour, At rest). Also a Stats heading's subject.
toolbar.shotFraming: Shot type filter group: how much of the frame the animal fills (Close, Environmental).
toolbar.tier: Filter label: the species' rarity tier (Legendary, Rare...).
toolbar.tierIn: Rarity filter label when the tier is the local one for a region. {region} is a region name.
toolbar.addTag: Tag filter dropdown placeholder once a tag is chosen: pick one more tag to match as well.
toolbar.moreValues: Summary of a filter with many values: the first one and how many more, e.g. "British Columbia + 3 more". {first} is a name, {count} a number.
toolbar.showOnly: Heading above the filter checkboxes (Featured, Missing a date): show only the photos that match.
toolbar.rating: Filter heading and menu label: the photos' star rating (1 to 5 stars).
toolbar.ratingAtMost: Saved filter summary: photos rated {count} stars or fewer.
toolbar.ratingExactly: Rating filter option and summary: exactly {count} stars (1 to 5).
toolbar.ratingRange: Saved filter summary: photos rated from {min} to {max} stars, e.g. 3 to 4 stars.
toolbar.unrated: Rating filter option: only photos with no star rating yet.
toolbar.searchingIn: Filter heading above the removable "In trip X" / "In album X" chips: the search is limited to that trip or album.
toolbar.region: Region filter heading, and the Group menu option that groups photos by the region they were taken in.
toolbar.missingCoordinates: Filter for photos with no coordinates (they may still have a country or province).

gallery.unknownRegion: Group heading for photos with no region when the grid is grouped by region.

shotType.flying: Shot action: the animal is flying.
shotType.behavior: Shot action: the animal is doing something (eating, hunting, fighting, playing, bathing).
shotType.resting: Shot action: the animal is at rest (perched, standing, swimming, walking).
shotType.close: Shot framing: the animal fills much of the frame (a portrait or close-up).
shotType.environmental: Shot framing: the animal is small in a wide scene of its habitat.

map.photoCount: After a place picked on the map. {formatted} is {count} as a formatted number.
map.grouped: Appended to the map's summary when a huge library's points were merged into a coarser grid.
map.noBasemap: Above the Gallery's map when the offline basemap isn't downloaded; countries still show as outlines.

card.noExactTag: Tile tag in the photo list beside the map: this photo has only a region, no coordinates. Keep it short.
card.ringLine: Hover card over a hollow ring on the map: photos filed under a region but with no coordinates. {region} is the region's name.
card.breakdown: Hover card and panel line for a map cluster holding both kinds: {placed} photos with coordinates, {regionOnly} with only a region. Both are formatted numbers.
card.noExactLocation: In the side panel for a map cluster: a region's photos that have only the region, no coordinates. Shown beside the region's name.
card.showAll: Link at the foot of the card over a map dot: opens all of that place's photos beside the map.
card.more: Last tile in the card's photo grid when there are more photos than shown; {formatted} is how many more, like 1,204.
card.spotsMore: Title of the map's hover card for a photo dot or cluster with several saved spots under it. {names} is the first two spot names as a list.

tilt.label: Accessible name of the two-way switch over the Gallery map between 3D and Flat.
tilt.auto: Switch option: the map tilts to one fixed 3D angle when zoomed in far enough, and is flat otherwise. Keep it short.
tilt.flat: Switch option: the map never tilts. Keep it short.

map.showUnlocated: Link beside the map's status line: opens the Gallery grid filtered to the photos with no coordinates.
map.searchPlaces: Placeholder of the offline place search above the Gallery map; it searches saved spots and region names.
map.placed: Toast after photos were given a point on the map. {formatted} is {count} formatted.
map.undo: Toast button that puts back the photos' previous locations.

placing.someLocated: While placing: how many of the photos already have coordinates (for example from the camera).
placing.allLocated: While placing: every one of the photos already has coordinates.
placing.modeLabel: Screen reader name of the choice between keeping or replacing existing locations.
placing.onlyMissing: Choice: place only the photos that have no coordinates yet (the default).
placing.replaceAll: Choice: also replace the coordinates photos already have.
placing.place: Main button that sets the picked point on the photos. {formatted} is {count} formatted.
placing.saveSpot: Button: save the picked point as a named saved spot.
placing.title: Title of the map's side panel while photos picked in the Gallery are being placed. {formatted} is {count} formatted.

status.some: Status line above the Gallery map. {placed} is the formatted number of photos with coordinates; {formatted} is {count}, every photo the filters match. A photo with only a country or province is not placed.
status.all: Status line above the Gallery map when every photo has coordinates. {formatted} is {count} formatted.
status.none: Status line above the Gallery map when no photo has coordinates (some may have a region).

map.needPlacing: Button beside the map's status line that opens the Needs placing list. {formatted} is {count}, the photos with no coordinates.
map.removed: Toast after removing the coordinates of the photos at a map dot, with Undo. {formatted} is {count} formatted.
map.nothingToUndo: Toast when Undo (or Cmd/Ctrl+Z on the map) finds no location change left to put back.
map.placingProgress: Progress label while a big placement runs in the background.
map.placingFiles: Progress label of a placement's last step: the new GPS and place names are written into the photo files.
map.rateFailed: Error when a star rating set in the viewer opened from the map can't be saved.
map.openInGallery: Button in the map's side panel: shows the panel's photos as the Gallery grid instead.
map.showMore: Button at the end of a long list in the map's side panel: loads the next page.
map.selectAll: Ticks every photo of a group in the Needs placing list.
map.deselectAll: Unticks every photo of a group in the Needs placing list.
map.closePanel: Accessible name of the close (x) button of the map's side panel.
map.resizePanel: Accessible name of the drag handle between the map and its side panel.

panel.placeRing: Menu item in the photo panel for a map cluster: place the photos that have only this region, no coordinates. {region} is its name.
panel.move: Menu item in the map's side panel: starts placing the panel's photos somewhere else.
panel.removeLocation: Menu item in the map's side panel: clears the coordinates of the panel's photos (undoable).
panel.regionOnly: Subtitle of the side panel opened from a hollow region ring: these photos have a region but no coordinates.

pin.prompt: Top of the Needs placing list when no pin is on the map yet.
pin.lift: Button that removes the pin from the map without placing anything.

tray.title: Title of the map's side list of photos without coordinates, grouped by trip and shooting session.
tray.filterLabel: Accessible label of the All / Region only / No location switch in the Needs placing list.
tray.all: Needs placing switch: every photo without coordinates. Its count shows beside it.
tray.region: Needs placing switch: photos with a country or province but no coordinates.
tray.none: Needs placing switch: photos with no location at all.
tray.loading: Spinner label while the map's side panel loads photos.
tray.empty: Empty state of the Needs placing list.
tray.inTrip: After a trip's name in the Needs placing list: how many of its photos need placing. {formatted} is {count} formatted.
tray.noTrip: Heading in the Needs placing list over sessions that aren't part of a trip.
tray.group: A shooting session in the Needs placing list. {formatted} is {count} formatted; {date} is the day, like Sep 14, 2026.
tray.groupNoDate: A group of photos without a capture date in the Needs placing list. {formatted} is {count} formatted.
tray.place: Button on a group before a pin is down: drops a pin in the middle of the map.
tray.placeAll: Button under a trip's heading in the Needs placing list, before a pin is down: places every photo of the trip, not just one group.
tray.changeRegion: Button on a group (or under a trip's heading) in the Needs placing list: opens the region picker to file those photos under another country or province.
tray.regionSet: Toast after Change region in the Needs placing list, with an Undo button. {formatted} is {count} formatted.
tray.showPhotos: Button that opens a group in the Needs placing list to show (and tick) its photos.
tray.hidePhotos: Button that closes a group's photos again.
tray.outside: Note under a group's Place button when the pin is outside the group's province or country. {region} is its name.
tray.movesRegion: Note under a group's Place button when the pin is a saved spot in another region: filing them there changes their region. {from} and {to} are region names.
tray.preview: Accessible name of a small thumbnail in a Needs placing group; opens it in the viewer. {index} is its position, 1 to 4.

layers.button: Name and hover text of the icon-only button at the top right of the photo map that opens the map layers panel (Map or Satellite, online detail).
layers.map: Option in the photo map's Layers panel: the drawn map (as opposed to satellite imagery).
layers.satellite: Option in the photo map's Layers panel and in Settings > General > Map and places, and the layers button's label while it is shown: satellite imagery.
layers.baseLabel: Screen-reader name of the Map / Satellite choice in the photo map's Layers panel.
layers.online: Heading of the Automatic / Off choice in the photo map's Layers panel: whether street-level map detail loads from the internet.
layers.auto: Option: online map detail loads by itself when zoomed in and online. The default.
layers.off: Option: the map never uses the internet.
layers.detailNote: Under Automatic in the Layers panel. {detail} is the tile provider's name (OpenFreeMap). Says plainly what is sent.
layers.offNote: Under Off in the Layers panel.
layers.satelliteNote: In the Layers panel while Satellite is picked, and once on the map the first time. {imagery} is the imagery provider's name or a web address.
layers.imageryLimit: Honest note while Satellite is picked: the free imagery is about 10 metres per pixel.
layers.failed: Quiet line on the photo map when online tiles could not load (offline or the provider is down); the offline map stays.
layers.slow: Quiet line under the map's layers button when online map detail is taking a while on a slow connection; the offline map shows meanwhile. Not an error.

edits.rateSomeFailed: {failed} photos of {count} selected couldn't be rated.
edits.reassignSomeFailed: {failed} photos of {count} couldn't be moved to another species.
edits.trashed: Toast after deleting. Trash is the app's bin for deleted items (its own page); one item reads without a number.

library.folderLayout: <libraryLink> links to Settings > Library, where "Folder layout" is the setting's name. {folder} is a folder path like "Wildlife <year taken>/".
library.editedJpeg: Placeholder inside a folder path diagram: Birds/<species name>/Adjusted/<your edited JPEG>. Folder names stay in English because Lifer writes them on disk.
library.matchingRaw: Placeholder inside a folder path diagram: Birds/<species name>/RAW/<matching RAW file>.
library.speciesName: Placeholder inside a folder path diagram: Birds/<species name>/Adjusted/...
library.yearTaken: Placeholder inside a folder name: Wildlife <year taken>/, the year the photo was taken.

trip.folders: "Adjusted" and "RAW" are folder names Lifer looks for on disk; keep them in English.

hiddenSpecies.allScope: Fills {scope} in "N species in {scope}" when no country is picked.
hiddenSpecies.count: Count above the grid of hidden species. {scope} is a country or province name, or "all hidden species".
hiddenSpecies.drillIn: Label before a picker that narrows the list to one country, then one province or state.

unhideChildren.title: {names} is a list of province or state names, already joined ("Ontario and Quebec").

hiddenSpecies.wholeCountry: Picker entry for species hidden from the country itself rather than one of its provinces.
hiddenSpecies.noneInScope: {scope} is a region name, like British Columbia, or the phrase for all hidden species.

hotspotMap.radius: {radius} is a distance in kilometres around an approximate point.
hotspotMap.title: Collapsible row on a species page: a map of areas where the species has historically been recorded (GBIF record clusters).
hotspotMap.titleIn: Same heading as the Locality map title, naming the region the map shows. {region} is a region name like Canada.
hotspotMap.noneIn: Note on a species page. {species} is the species name, {region} the region the user is viewing. It ends with a colon before a list of other region names, ones with hotspots or where the user photographed it.
hotspotMap.lastSeenAcross: Map popup. {year} is the most recent year the species was recorded in this area, {years} how many distinct years it was.
hotspotMap.sensitiveWithheld: eBird Sensitive Species: eBird's list of species whose exact locations are hidden to protect them. Use eBird's term in your language if it has one.
hotspotMap.recordShare: Map popup. {percent} is this area's share of all records of the species in the region, {count} the number of records.
hotspotMap.areaRadius: After approximate coordinates. {radius} is a distance in kilometres; the point is the centre of an area.
hotspotMap.locationsLastSeen: After the Locality map heading. {year} is the most recent year any record was made.
hotspotMap.sensitiveBadge: Short badge on a location in the list: the species is eBird-sensitive there.
hotspotMap.locationsOf: Locality map heading: {shown} locations pass the filters out of {count}.

compare.yourPick: On a species card the user searched for and added to the compare strip, in place of a match percent: it was their choice, not a suggestion.

animal.identify: Button while the user moves a box over one animal in their photo: matches species on that animal only.

known.edited: New photos whose file changed since an earlier import, probably edited in another app.
known.inLifer: First line after a folder or files are picked. {total} is every picked file, formatted with digit grouping; joined to skippedCount and newCount with commas.
known.newCount: Ends the line started by inLifer, e.g. "42 of 50 files are already in Lifer, 8 are new".
known.clear: Link that sends picked files whose exact content is already in the library to the system Trash, after a confirmation.
known.cleared: Toast after Clear out. {count} is files moved to the Trash; {sidecars} is the .xmp sidecar files (metadata files other photo apps keep beside a photo) that went with them.

recentFolders.title: Label before buttons for folders the user imported from before (desktop app).
recentFolders.newCount: Inside a recent folder's button: photos added to that folder since the last import.

skippedManager.open: Link on the import screen opening the list of photos left out of earlier imports. {formatted} is the count.
skippedManager.forget: Removes one photo from the list, so importing its folder again offers it again.

places.groupTitle: Heading of one group of photos on the import screen (photos taken in one outing). {formatted} is the formatted count, {date} a short date such as "Sep 14", {span} a time or a time range.
places.timeSpan: Two clock times, the first and last photo of a group, e.g. "07:10 to 08:02".
places.groupLabel: Screen reader name of a group of import photos. {time} is the first photo's clock time.
places.fromCamera: Button showing where a group of photos was taken, read from the camera's GPS. {place} is "near {town}", a region name, or "GPS point".
places.near: Lower case, follows "From the camera:". {town} is the nearest town from Lifer's offline town list.
places.cameraPoint: Lower case, follows "From the camera:" when no town or region is known for the point.
places.mixed: Button on a group where only some photos have camera GPS. {withGps} and {without} are formatted counts of photos.
places.sameAs: Button or menu item: give this group of photos the place of the earlier group. {time} is that group's first clock time.
places.labelTitle: Dialog title: a free-text place label for the photos. {formatted} is the formatted count.
places.dialogTitle: Dialog title: choose where the photos were taken. {formatted} is the formatted count.

raw.linkedCount: How many picked RAW files were matched to photos already in the library.
raw.pendingCount: How many picked RAW files are still uploading. Shown after the matched and not-imported counts, joined by middle dots.
raw.unmatchedCount: How many picked RAW files matched no photo in the library, so weren't imported. Shown after the matched count, joined by a middle dot.

trip.label: Label of a dropdown on the import screen: the trip the photos being imported join.
trip.none: Dropdown option: the imported photos join no trip.
trip.addingTo: Above the trip dropdown on the import screen. {name} is the trip the photos will join.
trip.active: Dropdown group heading: trips going on now.
trip.other: Dropdown group heading: every other trip.

cullMarks.summary: On an import screen. {count} photos picked, {rejected} (a formatted number) flagged as rejected by a culling app such as Photo Mechanic or Lightroom.
cullMarks.hide: Option for the rejected photos: import them, but hidden from the gallery and life list.

invertebrate.message: Shown on an imported photo that looks like an insect or spider. {looksLike} is an English phrase such as "a bee" or "a spider".
invertebrate.searchOptIn: Tooltip on the button when iNaturalist search is still off: pressing it turns that setting on.

meta.rawMatch: Shown after the picked species: this RAW file pairs with a photo already imported.
meta.editedVersion: Shown after the picked species: this edited file (such as a JPEG exported from a RAW) joins a photo already imported as one of its versions.
meta.samePhotoAs: Shown after the picked species: this file is the same shot as another file in this import (such as a RAW and its edited export), so it takes that file's species and imports with it as one photo. {name} is the other file's name, such as 6F9A8074.CR3.

review.duplicateExact: {species} is the earlier photo's species; {date} is its formatted capture date, shown only when known (dated is yes or no).
review.duplicateSimilar: Same as duplicateExact, for a near-duplicate.
review.notWildlife: {looksLike} is an English phrase from the image model, such as "a car".
review.looksLike: On an import row started from a species page: species matching thinks the photo shows {species}, a different species than the page's. Followed by the useSpecies button.
review.useSpecies: Link button on an import row: change this photo's species to {species}, a species name.

rows.filed: Toast after importing: how many photos went to how many species.
rows.placesSet: Toast after an import, with Undo: the places chosen on the import screen were applied. {formatted} is {count} formatted.
rows.placesFailed: Error toast: the import worked but applying the chosen places failed.
rows.filesCount: First part of the status line over the import list; the parts are joined by middle dots and a part with a zero count is left out.
rows.notWildlifeCount: A part of the import status line, joined with middle dots: files that don't look like wildlife and won't be imported.
rows.photoFormatUnknown: Shown in the thumbnail box when a file's format can't be named (otherwise JPEG, HEIC, etc.).
rows.importPhotos: Import button. With 0 it reads just "Import photos" (disabled).
rows.assignSelected: Before a species picker: give the {count} selected rows that species.
rows.optional: Hint next to the Location field label.
rows.tripHint: Notice after an import. {name} is a trip whose dates the photos fall in, though they weren't added to it.
rows.unsupported: Import screen, after picking or dropping files: some aren't a format Lifer imports (a GIF, a text file). {names} lists up to five file names, comma separated; {more} counts the rest.
rows.reassignFailed: Error toast after importing a RAW file that belongs to a photo already in the library, when the user had picked a different species for it.
rows.undoKept: Notice after Undo of an import: some imported files joined photos that were already in the library, and Lifer couldn't tell which file to take off, so it changed nothing on those photos.

move.label: A switch beside the Import drop area, desktop app only. On: originals are moved to the system Trash after they're safely copied into the library.
move.stayed: Ends the import summary, after moved and cleared, e.g. "Moved 42 photos into your library. Moved 3 already in Lifer to the Trash. 3 originals stayed where they were." Counts only originals Lifer didn't move.
move.moved: Starts the import summary. {sidecars} is how many .xmp sidecar files (metadata files other photo apps keep beside a photo) went to the Trash with the photos, e.g. "Moved 8 photos and 6 sidecar files into your library."
move.cleared: After moved in the import summary: files the library already had, sent to the Trash, with their .xmp sidecar files.

space.tight: Calm note on the Import page when the computer's disk is nearly full; importing still works, only slower.
space.paused: Shown when the import stopped because the disk is almost full. {free} and {toFree} are sizes like "2.1 GB"; {imported} of {total} photos made it in. Continue is the button beside it.
space.full: Shown when the disk is too full to start importing. {free} and {toFree} are sizes like "2.1 GB".

tripFit.one: Asked above a group of import photos taken during an existing trip. {dates} is the trip's date range, like "May 3 – 10, 2026".
tripFit.added: Shown on the group once the user chose Add to trip, before importing.

skipped.similar: Import page list of photos that look like ones already in Lifer but aren't exact copies (maybe edited). {formatted} is the count with digit grouping.

location.sent: Status line on a sighting. {when} is a relative time in the active locale, like "3 minutes ago".
location.failed: Status line on a sighting; a Retry button follows. {reason} picks the plain reason, written to follow the colon.
location.keep: Button: leave the location the user placed on iNaturalist as it is, instead of replacing it with the one set in Lifer.
location.summary: Toast after sending locations for many sightings. {updated} and {total} are numbers; the optional parts say how many wait for a later try or failed.

send.action: Menu item and selection-bar button: sends the photo or the selected photos to iNaturalist as observations.
send.sending: Toast shown while photos are being sent to iNaturalist in the background; it has a Cancel button.
send.nothingToSend: Toast when none of the chosen photos could be sent: already on iNaturalist, or the species has no iNaturalist match yet.
send.sent: Toast after sending. {count} is how many observations were created.
send.sentOneIncomplete: Toast after sending one observation with no location or date; iNaturalist opens so the person can add it.
send.sentIncomplete: Toast after sending several observations. {count} were sent and {incomplete} lack a location or date.
send.finish: Toast button: shows the To finish tab of the iNaturalist page.
send.view: Menu item for a photo already on iNaturalist: opens its observation there.
send.linkedExisting: Toast after sending: these sightings were already on iNaturalist (added by hand), so Lifer linked them instead of making a second observation.
send.maybeOnInat: Shown when Lifer held a send back: an observation the user made on iNaturalist themselves looks like these photos. Followed by two buttons.
send.checkMatches: Button: open the To send tab's Maybe on iNaturalist list to compare the photos.
send.sendAnyway: Button: send these photos as a new observation even so.

inaturalist.title: Page title. iNaturalist is a citizen-science site; keep the name as is.

tabs.label: Screen-reader name for the row of tabs.
tabs.import: Tab: sightings in Lifer not yet sent to iNaturalist.
tabs.pending: Tab: sent observations still missing a location or date, to add on iNaturalist.
tabs.completed: Tab: observations on iNaturalist with everything they need.

import.summary: One line under the tabs: how photos are grouped into sightings, and how to preview, open or select cards.
import.viewLabel: Screen-reader name for the Waiting/Ignored switch.
import.waiting: Switch option: sightings waiting to be sent.
import.search: Placeholder and label of the species search box.
import.shownCount: Selection bar when nothing is selected: how many sightings are listed.
import.sendSelected: Selection bar button: sends the selected sightings, one observation each. In the Ignored view this also takes them out of Ignored.
import.ignoreSelected: Selection bar button: ignores every photo in the selected sightings.
import.restoreSelected: Selection bar button in the Ignored view: restores the selected sightings.
import.morePhotos: Over the last photo on a card: how many more photos the sighting has.
import.sendPhotos: Sighting window button: sends the ticked photos as one observation.
import.ignoreSighting: Sighting window button: ignores every photo of this sighting.
import.ignoreUnticked: Sighting window button: ignores just the photos left out.
import.restoreSighting: Sighting window button in the Ignored view: brings its photos back to Waiting without sending.
import.tickAll: Sighting window link: puts every photo back in.
import.untickAll: Sighting window link: leaves every photo out.
import.ignored: Toast after ignoring photos; it has an Undo button.
import.restored: Toast after restoring ignored photos; it has an Undo button.
import.undo: Toast button: reverses the ignore or restore.
import.ignoreFailed: Error when ignoring or restoring fails.
import.noMatch: Shown when the search or location filter hides every sighting.
import.sendAll: Selection bar button: sends every listed sighting in the background, after asking once.
import.sendAllTitle: Confirmation title before sending every sighting. {count} is how many.
import.sendAllMessage: Confirmation text. {noLocation} is how many sightings have no location; empty when none.
import.missing: Note on a sighting row, shown before sending: what its photos don't record.
import.notMatched: Note on a sighting row whose species has no iNaturalist match, so it can't be sent.
import.photosAndDate: Row detail: {photos} is the photo count text, {date} the date or date range.
import.somePhotos: Row detail when some photos are unticked: {kept} of {count} photos will be sent.
import.includePhoto: Screen-reader label for the tick on each photo thumbnail. {n} is its position, {count} the total.
import.showAllPhotos: Screen-reader name for the +N tile on a card: opens a window with every photo. {count} is the total.
import.openPhoto: Screen-reader name for a photo thumbnail in a card's photo window: opens it full size in the viewer. {n} is its position, {count} the total.

empty.title: Empty state heading when nothing is left to send.

ignoredEmpty.title: Empty state heading for the Ignored view.
ignoredEmpty.description: Empty state text for the Ignored view.

import.missingShort: Status on a sighting card: what its photos don't record, added on iNaturalist after sending.
import.notMatchedShort: Status on a sighting card whose species has no iNaturalist match.
import.preview: Card button (magnifier) and menu item: shows the card's pictures full size.
import.previewShortcut: Shortcut shown in the Preview tooltip: the Space key (Enter works too).
import.select: Card menu item: adds the sighting to the selection.
import.deselect: Card menu item: takes the sighting out of the selection.
import.leftOut: Label over a photo in the sighting window that won't be sent.
import.windowHint: Hint in the sighting window above its photos: a click views a photo, its corner tick leaves it out of the send.
import.onInat: Note on a To send card: one of its photos looks the same as an observation the user already made on iNaturalist themselves.
import.ignoredMark: Status on a sighting card shown with ignored ones: this sighting is ignored.
import.choosePhotos: Sighting card menu item: opens its window to pick which photos to send, or to ignore it.
import.locationFrom: Sighting window: the location iNaturalist gets comes from the photos' own coordinates. {mode} is one (a single photo), all (every ticked photo) or some; {located} of {count} ticked photos have a location.
import.locationFromNear: Same as locationFrom, with {place}: the photos' place label and region, like Pigeon Lake, Alberta.
import.changePlace: Link after the location line in the sighting window: shows the place chooser to file the photos under a named place instead.
import.noLocationChoose: Sighting window, above the place chooser, when no ticked photo has a location. {count} is how many photos are ticked.

pending.steps: Explains that the person finishes observations on iNaturalist and Lifer notices by itself.
pending.checkNow: Button: asks iNaturalist about the unfinished observations right away.
pending.finished: Toast when Lifer finds observations finished on iNaturalist and moves them to Completed.
pending.needs: Card status on To finish: what the observation still needs on iNaturalist.
pending.finish: Button: opens the observation's edit page on iNaturalist.
pending.checkSelected: Selection bar button on To finish: asks iNaturalist about the selected observations right away.
pending.needsLabel: Label of the To finish filter for what an observation is missing.
pending.needsLocation: Filter option: observations still missing a location.
pending.needsDate: Filter option: observations still missing a date.

inaturalist.intro: One-line purpose of the iNaturalist page under its title.
inaturalist.connectedAs: Under the page intro. {username} is the person's iNaturalist username; <a> opens their iNaturalist profile.
inaturalist.loadFailed: Shown with a Retry button when the page's lists can't load.

notConnected.title: Empty state heading when no iNaturalist account is connected.
notConnected.description: Explains where to connect the account.

completed.locationInat: Row detail: the person placed the location on iNaturalist and Lifer copied it back.
completed.withDateInat: Row detail when a photo with no date took the date added on iNaturalist. {location} is the location source text.
completed.fromPhoto: Completed filter option: the location or date came from the photo itself.
completed.fromInat: Completed location filter option: the location was placed on iNaturalist.
completed.dateLabel: Label of the Completed filter for where the date came from.
completed.dateFromInat: Completed date filter option: the date was added on iNaturalist and copied to the photo.
completed.found: Line on a Completed card: the user made this observation on iNaturalist themselves, and Lifer found it and linked their photo to it.

inaturalist.photoCount: Row detail: how many photos an observation or sighting has.
inaturalist.observationCount: Selection bar on To finish and Completed when a search or filter hides some: how many are listed.

species.trailLabel: Screen-reader name for the trail back from one species.
species.allSpecies: Link at the start of the trail: back to every species on this tab.
species.backTip: Tooltip of the All species link.
species.backShortcut: Shortcut shown in that tooltip: the Esc key.
species.count: How many species cards a search or filter leaves.
species.itemsAndPhotos: Species card line: {items} is the sighting or observation count, {photos} the photo count.
species.open: Species card menu item: shows that species' sightings or observations.
species.noLocation: Species card status on To send: how many of its sightings have no location.
species.notMatched: Species card status on To send when the species has no iNaturalist match.
species.needLocation: Species card status on To finish: how many observations still need a location.
species.needDate: Species card status on To finish: how many observations still need a date.
species.noDate: Species card status on To send: how many of its sightings have no date.

existing.noModel: Shown after the check when the optional species-matching model isn't downloaded: without it Lifer can't compare pictures.
existing.reading: Progress label while the observations are downloaded; a count like (200 of 1,500) follows.
existing.comparing: Progress label while each observation's preview is compared with the user's photos; a count follows.
existing.linked: Toast when the check (started by the user or by Lifer in the background) linked photos.
existing.noneFound: Toast when a check the user started found nothing new.
existing.failed: Shown when the check, Link or Not a match fails, usually because iNaturalist can't be reached.

matches.view: Segment on the To send tab, with a count: possible matches between the user's photos and their iNaturalist observations, to confirm or reject.
matches.summary: Explanation at the top of that list.
matches.empty: Shown when every possible match has been linked or rejected.
matches.onInat: Caption on the observation's photo in a possible-match card; the other half shows the user's photo. Keep it short.
matches.yourPhoto: Caption on the user's own photo in a possible-match card.

likeness.same: How alike the two pictures are, in words (no numbers): nearly identical.
likeness.probably: How alike the two pictures are, in words: very alike, but not certain.
likeness.unknown: The pictures couldn't be compared (no image model, or the preview couldn't be downloaded).

taxon.same: Evidence that matched: the observation is the photo's species. Joined with the other evidence by commas.
taxon.finer: Same, when iNaturalist names a subspecies of the photo's species.
taxon.related: The observation's name is broader than or different from the photo's species, but related.

time.close: Evidence, after a comma: taken within about two minutes of the observation's time. Lowercase.
time.sameDay: Evidence, after a comma: taken the same day. Lowercase.

size.same: Evidence, after a comma: the iNaturalist photo has the same shape. Lowercase.
size.different: Evidence, after a comma: the iNaturalist photo was cropped or resized. Lowercase.

matches.place: Evidence, after a comma: both have a location close together. Lowercase.
matches.link: Button on a possible-match card: yes, this photo is in that observation.
matches.notMatch: Button on a possible-match card: no, and never suggest this pair again.
matches.dismissed: Toast after Not a match on a possible-match card.
matches.undo: Toast button: undo Not a match and show the card again.
matches.unlink: Menu item and button on an observation Lifer found on iNaturalist (made there by the user): undo the link, so its photos go back to To send as they were before.
matches.unlinked: Toast after Unlink or after Undo on a link.
matches.unlinkedKept: Same toast when some photos' location or date was changed by the user after linking: those changes stay.

toolbar.filters: Toolbar button: opens the filters for this tab.
toolbar.clearFilters: Filters panel link: turns every filter off.
toolbar.cardSize: View menu slider: how wide the cards are.
toolbar.taxon: Filters heading: groups of life such as birds or mammals.
toolbar.has: Filter option: sightings that have a location (or a date).
toolbar.needs: Filter option: sightings still without a location (or a date).
toolbar.matched: Filters heading: whether the species has a match on iNaturalist, which sending needs.
toolbar.matchedYes: Filter option: species matched on iNaturalist.
toolbar.matchedNo: Filter option: species with no iNaturalist match yet, so they can't be sent.
toolbar.show: Filters heading on To send: waiting sightings, ignored ones, or both.
toolbar.ignoredCount: Show filter option: ignored sightings. # is how many.
toolbar.both: Show filter option: waiting and ignored sightings together.
toolbar.origin: Filters heading on Completed: whether Lifer sent the observation or found one made on iNaturalist.

inaturalist.previewCaption: Caption under a picture in the preview: the species name and the day it was photographed.

observations.details: Observation card menu item: opens its window with all its photos and its actions.

badge.assessedTitle: Hover text on the IUCN badge.
badge.label: Badge on a species page. {category} is an IUCN Red List category name, like Least Concern.

category.extinct: IUCN Red List category name. Use the official IUCN Red List term in your language if one exists.
category.lowerRiskConservationDependent: Old (1994) IUCN Red List category, still on a few assessments. Use the official IUCN term if one exists.

lightbox.revealHint: Tooltip on the photo viewer's Show in Finder button beside the file names.
lightbox.viewSpecies: Link in the photo viewer to the photo's species page. The arrow marks it as leaving the viewer.
lightbox.noDate: In the photo viewer's caption, after the species name, for one of your photos with no capture date. Where a date shows, it reads like Nov 17, 2026, 7:42 PM.

deleteConfirm.title: {tag} is a tag name the user made.

managePlaces.renameLabel: Screen-reader name of the rename field. {name} is a place name the user typed, like Pigeon Lake.
managePlaces.renamed: After renaming a place name. {count} is how many photos changed.
managePlaces.renamedAndMoved: After renaming a place name when the folder layout has place folders. {count} photos changed, {moved} files moved into the new folder, {failed} files couldn't be moved (the clause is left out at 0).
managePlaces.removed: After removing a place name. {count} is how many photos lost it.
managePlaces.removedAndMoved: After removing a place name when the folder layout has place folders. {count} photos changed, {moved} files moved out of the place folder, {failed} files couldn't be moved (the clause is left out at 0).

mergeConfirm.title: Renaming a place name to one already in use joins them. {from} and {to} are place names the user typed.
mergeConfirm.message: {to} is the place name already in use, {count} how many photos carry the old name.

removeConfirm.title: {name} is a place name the user typed, {count} how many photos carry it.

placeName.detail: After a suggested place name: its region (and country) and how many of the user's photos carry it. Starts with a middle dot separating it from the name.
placeName.detailNoRegion: After a suggested place name with no region: how many of the user's photos carry it.
placeName.regionInCountry: A region and the country it is in, like Alberta, Canada.
placeName.photoCount: Shown after a place name's region in the place picker, joined by the app's list separator.

nameChanged.title: Modal title: a species the user has photos of was split by taxonomists into several species.
nameChanged.splitInto: {name} is the old common name, {scientificName} its scientific name (in <i>), {count} how many species it became, {photos} how many of the user's photos are affected.
nameChanged.thisOne: Button next to one of the new species: move the photos to it.
nameChanged.keep: Button: keep the old name for these photos. {scientificName} is the old scientific name.

nav.appWith: Hover tooltip on a sidebar app entry. {label} is the short sidebar label (what it does), {name} the app's own name. Keep the names as they are.
nav.map: Sidebar and top-bar link to the Gallery's map layout, where photos show as pins by where they were taken.
nav.inaturalist: Sidebar and top-bar link to the iNaturalist page; shown only once an iNaturalist account is connected. Keep the product name.

offlinePacks.offline: Shown on download screens only when the computer is offline or the download host can't be reached at all: installed regions still show and work, but nothing new can be downloaded.
offlinePacks.slow: Shown beside a small spinner when the download host answers slowly (a weak signal). Downloads still work, just slower; keep it short and calm.

downloaded.groupRemoving: Progress line under a country's header while its regions are being removed, shown even when the country is collapsed. {done} regions are gone so far, # is the total.
downloaded.groupUpdating: Progress line under a country's header while its regions are being updated, shown even when collapsed.
downloaded.selectCountry: Screen-reader name of the checkbox that selects every downloaded pack of one country. {country} is its name.

offload.addedSpecies: Confirm dialog line when bulk removal includes species the user added from iNaturalist. {size} is a formatted file size, like 12 MB.
offload.titleManyItems: Items are downloaded regions plus groups of species the user added from iNaturalist.

provinceManager.loading: {subdivisions} is the country's word for its subdivisions, lowercased and in English from the data: provinces, states or regions.
provinceManager.none: {subdivisions} is the country's word for its subdivisions, lowercased and in English from the data: provinces, states or regions.
provinceManager.working: Next to a province while it is being removed or downloaded again.

offlinePacks.provinces: Button on a downloaded country's row that opens its list of provinces or states. The server may replace it with the country's own word (States, Regions).

recommend.covers: One suggested download. {name} is a region name, maybe with an animal group in brackets; {size} is a file size like 120 MB.
recommend.intro: Shown after the library reimport tool found species with no reference photos or info.

selection.addToQueue: Footer button while a region download runs: adds the selected regions to the end of the running download.
selection.queued: Short confirmation after the selection joined a running download. # is how many regions were added; =0 when they were all queued already.
selection.summary: Summary of what will download: how many countries, how many animal groups (none picked means all animals), and the total size like 1.2 GB.
selection.summaryNoSize: The same while the size (photos included) isn't known yet, briefly on a first start; ends with an ellipsis like other in-progress notes.

status.failed: {error} is the server's error message, in English.

taxonPicker.groupCount: A collapsible group of animal classes. {group} is its name (like Shells); then how many of its classes are picked.

variant.full: Download size option: every reference photo for each species.
variant.fullSize: Compares sizes: what the other (Full) download option would be. {size} is like 1.2 GB.
variant.small: Download size option: one featured photo per species.
variant.smallSize: Compares sizes: what the other (Small) download option would be. {size} is like 300 MB.

add.phrase: Fills the search box when a starter group is tapped and a place was already typed, like Spiders of Canada. {group} is the group's name, {place} what the user typed.
add.taxonValue: The Group chip: the group's common name, then its rank and scientific name, like Spiders, order Araneae.
add.taxonDetail: Second line of a group in the chip's list: rank and scientific name ({what}, like order Araneae) and how many iNaturalist observations it has.
add.count: Live preview above a few example species: how many species the list would add.
add.estimate: How long adding the list takes; it runs in the background.
add.bigList: For a list over the size limit. {size} is the batch size formatted with digit grouping, like 5,000.
add.growthForm: {query} is what the user typed, like trees; iNaturalist has no single group for trees or shrubs.
add.button: The dialog's main button. {region} is the Lifer region whose checklist gets the species.
add.buttonIdle: The main button before a group and place are picked (disabled).
add.alsoTarget: Checkbox in Add a list from iNaturalist: every species the list adds, now and in later batches, also goes on a new target list named after the list.

starters.lepidoptera: A tappable starter group under the search box (iNaturalist order Lepidoptera).

errors.noRegion: The place picked has no Lifer region with a checklist (for example a park or a town), so the list has nowhere to go.

status.nextBatch: A big list is added in batches; {when} is a relative time like in 3 hours.
status.done: Under a finished list's name: how many species it added.

photos.pending: How many of the list's species already have a reference photo, which Lifer needs to suggest them for your photos.

actions.update: Menu item: read the list from iNaturalist again to add newly recorded species.
actions.continue: Starts the next batch of a big list now instead of waiting.
actions.untarget: Menu item on a list from iNaturalist that was set to add its species to targets: takes those targets back and stops adding more.

remove.message: Confirm dialog body. {count} is how many species the list added, {region} the region they were added to.

toast.removedKept: {kept} is how many of the list's species stay because the user photographed or marked them.
toast.untargeted: Toast after Remove these targets. {name} is the list's name, like Spiders of Canada.

otherTaxa.title: Modal for adding a species Lifer has no data for (insects, plants, fungi) from iNaturalist to a region's list.
otherTaxa.noChecklist: {region} is a region name, like a continent, that can't hold a species list of its own.
otherTaxa.importing: Progress label while a pasted list of species is being imported.
otherTaxa.bulkSummary: After a bulk import, possibly after "Done." or "Cancelled.". {added} and {alreadyPresent} are species counts.
otherTaxa.bulkSummaryNotFound: Same, plus {notFound}: how many lines matched no iNaturalist species.
otherTaxa.notFoundList: Followed by a list of the entries that matched nothing.

species.heading: Filters panel section heading on a trip's photos: pick one or more of the trip's species, each with its photo count.
species.search: Placeholder and label of the box that narrows a long species list in that section.
species.clear: Link under the species list: unpicks every species.

appearance.findPlumage: Placeholder and label of the box that narrows a long list of the plumages (breeding, eclipse, first winter...) used on the library's photos, in the Filters panel's Appearance section.
appearance.clearPlumage: Link under that plumage list: unpicks every plumage.
appearance.findMorph: Placeholder and label of the box that narrows a long list of the colour morphs (dark morph, blue phase...) used on the library's photos, in the Filters panel's Appearance section.
appearance.clearMorph: Link under that morph list: unpicks every morph.

rawFiles.label: Filter heading: RAW-only files (photos with no edited JPEG) can be shown, hidden, or shown alone.
rawFiles.only: Filter option: show only RAW files.
rawFiles.unedited: Filter option: only RAW photos with no edited version yet (the photos still to edit).
rawFiles.uneditedHint: Shown under the RAW files filter while Not edited yet is chosen: an edit counts only once Lifer has linked it to the RAW as a version.

editedRaw.label: Filter heading: edited photos, filtered by whether a RAW file is paired with them.
editedRaw.any: Filter option: edited photos with or without a RAW.

date.to: Between the from and to date fields, as in "from [date] to [date]".

display.labels: Checkbox in every View menu: show a caption under each photo (the species name; on a species page, the date and place).
display.cameraInfo: Checkbox in every View menu: show the camera, lens and exposure under each photo.
display.ratings: Checkbox in every View menu: show each photo's star rating.

view.layout: View menu section heading: show the Gallery's photos as a grid or on a map.

sort.count: Sort option for grouped cards: the group with the most items first.

connectedApps.showInSidebar: Accessible name of a switch. {name} is the app's name.
connectedApps.hide: Sidebar context menu item. {name} is the app's name.
connectedApps.hidden: Toast after hiding an app from the sidebar. {name} is the app's name.
connectedApps.stop: Button that quits a companion app Lifer started, like quitting it from its own menu.
connectedApps.uninstallHint: Lifer opens apps but never deletes them; each app has its own uninstaller.

lightroom.found: {total} and {matched} are counts of photos, formatted with digit grouping.
lightroom.groupCounts: Under a switch for one kind of change. {total} is the number of items in the catalogue, {change} how many would change something in Lifer, {conflicts} how many have a different value in Lifer already.
lightroom.unmapped: Heading above a list of Lightroom collections Lifer can't turn into albums.
lightroom.unmappedMore: {count} is the number of collections not listed.
lightroom.notInLifer: {count} is a number of photos in the catalogue that Lifer doesn't have.
lightroom.done: Shown after the import. {photos} is a count formatted with digit grouping; {albums} a count.
lightroom.undo: Button that reverses the whole Lightroom import.

openIn.item: Menu item (desktop app): open the photo file in an installed photo editor. {name} is the editor, like Photoshop.
openIn.failed: Error toast. {name} is the editor, like Photoshop.
openIn.edited: Menu item (desktop app) for a photo with a RAW and an edited file: open the edited file, not the RAW. {name} is the editor.
openIn.with: Menu item (desktop app): open the photo in another installed editor than the chosen one. {name} is the editor, like darktable.
openIn.fallback: Info toast when the editor chosen in Settings was uninstalled. {name} is the editor used instead.
openIn.pickFailed: Error toast after choosing an app with Other... in Settings > General > Edit photos with.

libraryLocations.label: Settings > Storage heading: the drives and network shares (NAS) that hold the user's photo library.
libraryLocations.description: Description under the Library locations heading.
libraryLocations.connect: Button and menu item: mount a network share (NAS) so its photos can be opened. {name} is the share's name, like home or media.
libraryLocations.connecting: Toast while the computer mounts a network share. {name} is the share's name. The operating system may show its own password dialog.
libraryLocations.connected: Toast after a network share was mounted. {name} is the share's name.
libraryLocations.failed: Toast when mounting a network share failed or was cancelled. {name} is the share's name.
libraryLocations.notResponding: Status of a network share that is mounted but stopped answering (a dead network connection).
libraryLocations.serverConnected: Note after Not connected: the NAS server itself is reachable (another of its shares is mounted), but this share hasn't been opened.
libraryLocations.someOriginalsOn: Line above a species' photos when some original files are on a network share that isn't mounted. {name} is the share's name.
libraryLocations.bannerNotConnected: Notice under the toolbar when a drive or network share holding the library isn't mounted. {name} is its name.
libraryLocations.bannerNotResponding: Notice under the toolbar when a mounted network share stopped answering. {name} is its name.
libraryLocations.dismiss: Accessible label of the close button on the library location notice; once closed it never shows again for that share.

photoMenu.feature: Menu item: set this photo as the species' featured photo, the one its card shows.
photoMenu.correctId: Menu item: move the photo to the species it really shows.
photoMenu.revealInFinder: Menu item and button (desktop app): show the original file in the system file manager, as the OS words it (macOS: Show in Finder). {place} is Finder, File Explorer or file manager.
photoMenu.fileAction: A file action for one of a photo's several files (a RAW and its edit). {action} is the action, like Show in Finder or Copy file path; {file} is the file name, like IMG_1234.CR3.
photoMenu.connectVolume: Photo menu item when the original is on a disconnected drive. {volume} is the drive's name.
photoMenu.tagSpecies: Photo menu item: also list this photo under a second species that appears in it.
photoMenu.location: Photo menu item: opens the location dialog (coordinates, saved places, place name and region). The photo's place shows under it.

regionBrowser.drillIn: Before a picker of the current region's sub-regions (countries, provinces).
regionBrowser.noPacks: <a> wraps a link to the Species downloads page (in Settings > Species and import). Keep that page name as it is translated elsewhere.
regionBrowser.allRegions: First item of a region breadcrumb trail: back to the top of the region tree.
regionBrowser.searchPlaceholder: Placeholder of the box that searches every country, state and province by name. {name} is the region the user is working in, like Alberta; with none, searchLabel is the placeholder.
